name: Ancient Bracelet
overview: Healer A Zhao, a descendant of a goddess from the Wuyue Clan, falls in love with Ying Du, the ruler of the Puluo Kingdom, only to witness him massacre her clan and become bound to him across three lifetimes by a time-reversing bracelet. As A Zhao uncovers the truth and challenges heavenly law, she fights to break their cursed fate and reclaim their love.
